description.zh: 实例ID。最多指定100台实例ID，并使用半角逗号（,）隔开。
description.en: The instance ID. You can specify a maximum of 100 instance IDs in a single request. Separate the instance IDs with commas (,).

description.zh:
当前页码。起始值：1

默认值：1
description.en:
The page number. Pages start from page 1.

Default value: 1.

description.zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。取值范围：1~100

默认值：10
description.en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100.

Default value: 10.

description.zh: 实例所属的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID of the instances. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

description.zh: VPC ID。目标VPC必须已开启ClassicLink功能，详情请参见[建立ClassicLink连接](~~65413~~)。
description.en: The VPC ID. The ClassicLink feature must be enabled for the specified VPC. For more information, see [Establish a ClassicLink connection](~~65413~~).

title.zh: 查询建立了连接的经典网络类型实例

descriptions.zh:
调用该接口时，您需要注意：

-  该接口仅支持经典网络类型实例。
-  单次最多只能查询100台经典网络类型实例。
-  参数`VpcId`和`InstanceId`不能同时为空。
descriptions.en:
Take note of the following items:

- This operation applies only to instances that reside in the classic network.

- You can query a maximum of 100 instances that reside in the classic network at a time.

- At least one of the `VpcId` and `InstanceId` parameters must be configured.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs describe-classic-link-instances --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vpc-id vpc-bp1vwnn14rqpyiczj0000 --instance-id i-bp1a5zr3u7nq9cxh0000 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
